changes.title: Settings page
items: A Settings page (for now from the pause page's "Show settings page" button): change any key or pad button (two each; a key another action has asks Swap, Use both or Cancel), master, music, effects and voices volumes, mute when away, fullscreen and which screen (Chrome and Edge), quality, screen shake, reduce flashing, Talk held or toggled, text size, and your pad's button names (PlayStation or Xbox); by pad, keyboard or mouse, saved as you change them

changes.title: Chart opens here
items: The sea chart opens with the island you're on chosen, home included

changes.title: Pad layout
items: New gamepad layout: ✕ uses (opens a station, picks up and puts down sigils) and chooses in menus, ○ dodges and goes back, □ rises or lands, R1 and L1 cycle your sigils forward and back, either trigger throws 💌s, the d-pad zooms
Every control now lives in one bindings table, ready for a settings menu to remap: the on-screen button prompts and the controls list follow it
